evals.prompt: Customers want a better dashboard. Help me frame what to work on next, but don't design it yet.
evals.expected_output: Investigates who is affected, what they do now, what goes wrong, why now, and an appetite; does not jump to dashboard widgets or claim approval.

evals.prompt: Should we focus next on archived invoice uploads or giving employees access to past contracts? Help us decide.
evals.expected_output: Compares current workarounds and consequences rather than assigning numerical scores or shaping both solutions; names the human Frame Go decision.

evals.prompt: Support needs a production outage fixed today. Run Shape Up framing so we can put it in next month's cycle.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes urgent reactive work, recommends the appropriate immediate workflow instead of manufacturing a Shape Up frame or pitch.
